newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Three Spanish trawlers arrested off Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Three Spanish trawlers arrested off Ireland.

text.p: Three British-registered Spanish trawlers were arrested off the coast of Ireland on Saturday, an Irish naval spokesman said.
They were detained west of the southern port of Bantry "for alleged logbook offences", the spokesman said.
It was the latest in a series of incidents involving Spanish trawlers off the Irish coast.
A week ago an Irish fishing captain was killed when his vessel and a British-registered Spanish trawler collided off Ireland's southern tip.

On Friday an Irish naval ship was called out after the skipper of a trawler in a fleet from Cornwall, south-west England, claimed that he had been rammed by a Spanish trawler, Irish naval sources said.
